verdict.rationale: Luma documents text-to-video generation with Draft Mode, a cheap 360p tier suited to fast iteration. It also documents several ways to build on prior output: Modify Video V2 reshapes existing footage, Multi-Keyframe directs changes within a clip, and agents 'refine' assets. Hands-on users confirm that prompts produce clips, though quality is mixed and results are hard to steer toward demo level. That is a quality concern, not evidence the capability is missing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of extending or interpolating from a prior generation (only posed as FAQ questions), a clearly documented prompt-revision or variation workflow, and independent corroboration that iteration preserves prior results.
